subject: planner: Fix PointGet HandleColOffset (#51796)
summary: Reviewed this commit (vs first parent) in planner only. It updates optimizer-built `PointGetPlan` construction to compute `HandleColOffset` via resolved handle-column indices and adds a regression test covering a partitioned table where the int handle column is not the first column; Bazel sharding is adjusted for the new test. No remaining Blocker/High issues found after also checking later history up to `upstream/master`.
